brief: Stand up a Verifiable Trust Community on OpenVTC on your own machine as the community's core node — a VTA that mints and issues, a mediator, a DID host and the community itself, behind a tunnel, run as service units — with a keeper and an agent walking it together, the keeper typing every secret and the agent preparing, checking and recording. Use when someone wants to "build their own city", "set up a VTC", "deploy OpenVTC", "run a VTA / mediator / DID host / VTC", "connect Star Key" or "the VTA browser wallet", "issue invitations", "attach a community" to Mages City, or asks what the City did on 8–9 October 2026 and what broke. Encodes the shape, the order of work with who types what and the done-when per phase, every gotcha met on the first walk with its fix, the community's shape (criteria, profile, description), the attach path, and the refusals. The kit is `deploy/vti/` in github.com/mitchuski/mages.city.
